assumptions.household_source_file_visibility: Not modeled. Records carry a reference to the file, never the file.
assumptions.password_entry: None. A file that needs a password is refused, and the person is asked for an unlocked copy.
assumptions.source_file_retention: A stored file is deleted once no row from it is left in review.
assumptions.status: Experimental choices made to run the proof. Unresolved, and not approved production defaults.
